title: On an integral normal scheme the pushforward of a constant sheaf along the generic point or a nonempty open is again constant
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that on an integral normal scheme the pushforward of a constant sheaf along either the inclusion of the generic point or the inclusion of a nonempty open is again the constant sheaf (statement lines 12699-12709). The proof (proof lines 12711-12728) computes the stalks of g_*underline E using the normality of strict henselizations and the stalk description of pushforwards, and then deduces the statement for an open immersion from the factorisation g = j o (generic point of U) together with the density of the generic fibre over etale neighbourhoods. H2: one stalk computation plus one comparison, written out.
